claims.claim: CI fails if the new model breaks an assertion the old one passed.
The example lives at examples/model-migration/.
One scenario set, multiple providers registered, one report.
Identical assertions per scenario; each must pass on every registered model.
The report flags a model that fails an assertion the others passed.
run --ci exits non-zero when a model fails an assertion.
Run cd examples/model-migration before the next command.
promptarena serve starts the web UI for the current project.
The web UI lays the suite out as a scenario by provider matrix, one column per model.
Clicking a matrix cell filters the run ledger to that scenario and model pair.
Opening a run shows its output and assertion results.
A wide matrix scrolls sideways with the scenario column pinned.
promptarena run is a valid subcommand.
The --ci flag exists on promptarena run.
The --formats flag accepts json and markdown values.
A markdown report is written to out/results.md.
Both providers in the example are mock providers.
mock-responses-v2.yaml is a file in the example.
A mock response file keys responses by scenario ID and uses a turns map keyed by turn number.
The max_length assertion fires on v2 but not v1 for the edited response.
The assertion type content_includes is available.
The assertion type max_length is available.
The run prints Error: execution failed: 1 runs had errors, 1 assertions failed when the max_length turn assertion fails
The CI snippet uses set -e so a failing run fails the PR.
config.arena.yaml is the file that lists providers in the example.
config.arena.yaml providers entries use a file key.
providers/openai-gpt4o.provider.yaml exists in the example.
providers/openai-gpt4o-mini.provider.yaml exists in the example.
providers/anthropic-claude-haiku.provider.yaml exists in the example.
The report fans out across every registered provider and CI gates on all of them passing.
The workflow triggers on pull_request with paths examples/model-migration/**.
The example workflow uses Go 1.26 via actions/setup-go.
go build -o bin/promptarena ./arena/cmd/promptarena builds the CLI.
../../bin/promptarena run --ci --formats json,markdown runs the suite from examples/model-migration.
The example writes its report to examples/model-migration/out/.
Adding a third provider file requires only registering it in config.arena.yaml and running; the fan-out scales automatically.
